race.comment: MANOORA (1) started at $1.45 in a similar race to this at Muswellbrook two back but found one better. Subsequently got to the line with purpose to just miss the placings in an 1100m Randwick Highway. Perfectly placed to return to winning form. CURIE (2) returns from a six-month spell for a third campaign. Had a robust SP profile last prep, scoring at $1.06 at this track to break her maiden then failing at $1.35 at the last run before a spell. Two recent trials will have her ready to perform. WOOTTON PLEASE (10) had a seven-week let-up before her last start fourth over this distance at Coonabarabran. Freshened up again. Nicely weighted and should give a good account. CELESTIAL GRACE (7) had to dig deep to collect her maiden as a $1.90 elect last start over this distance at Bathurst. Handy mare who should measure up in this better company. ARCHAIC FORCE (6) is fitter for two runs back from a spell and is looking for this trip now.
